name: Edenbound
source:
Edenbound is a psychological horror sci-fi visual novel set on the lunar colony of EDEN over 1000 years in the future. 

About 600 years have passed since humanity has reached the singularity. With exponential strides in technological development, the ills of the past gradually start to fade; medical advancement would soon follow, and the collection and distribution of resources also continues to accelerate at an alarming pace. With the imminent threat of overpopulation approaching, humanity initiates what is known as the EDEN Project. After several years of development, a lunar colony is developed, and the populace is ready to begin expanding and migrating to the utopian city of EDEN.

The citizens of EDEN continue to prosper, as everything has become idyllic and automated. Humanity has achieved perfection. Anything is possible; everybody has the freedom to do whatever they want. 500 more years have passed, but with enough time, even paradise gets boring. With stagnation on the rise, the populace grows weary. Communications with Earth slow down, and the numbers on EDEN start to steadily decrease. Where have people started to disappear to? Have the residents of EDEN been forgotten? 

Wandering the streets of a massive vacated paradise, Eli Calvez lives out the rest of his days among the remaining denizens, finding solace in sleeping his days away; however, beset by a strange series of recurring dreams, Eli feels his sanity start to waver. Compelled to uncover the mysteries behind this collapsed utopia, the dwellers of EDEN find there is no rest in sleep.

[From [url=https://somnibear.itch.io/edenbound]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Edenbound》是一部心理恐怖科幻视觉小说，以1000多年后的月球殖民地伊甸园为背景。

自从人类达到奇点以来，已经过去了大约600年。随着技术的飞速发展，过去的弊病逐渐开始消失；医疗进步很快就会随之而来，资源的收集和分配也继续以惊人的速度加速。随着人口过剩的迫在眉睫的威胁逼近，人类启动了所谓的伊甸园计划。经过几年的发展，一个月球殖民地已经开发出来，人们已经准备好开始扩张并迁移到乌托邦城市伊甸园。

伊甸园的居民继续繁荣发展，一切都变得田园诗般的自动化。人类已经达到了完美。一切皆有可能；每个人都有做任何他们想做的事的自由。又过去了500年，但时间足够了，即使是天堂也会变得无聊。随着停滞的加剧，民众变得疲倦。与地球的通讯变慢，伊甸园上的人数开始稳步减少。人们开始消失到哪里？伊甸园的居民被遗忘了吗？

伊莱·卡尔维斯（Eli Calvez）在一片空旷的天堂的街道上漫步，与剩下的居民一起度过了余生，在睡眠中找到了慰藉；然而，被一系列奇怪的反复出现的梦所困扰，伊莱感觉自己的理智开始动摇。伊甸园的居民被迫揭开这个崩溃的乌托邦背后的秘密，他们发现睡眠中没有休息。
